people.name: Brett Bilbrey
people.astrocadeRole: Early Bally Arcade contributor, Action Graphics developer, and co-founder and game programmer at Spectre Systems.
people.industrySummary: Bilbrey later became an inventor and engineering leader in the computer industry. He retired as head of Apple's Technology Advancement Group after serving as a lead designer on projects including the Mac mini, Apple TV, and iSight technology. Before Apple, he was chief technologist at Intelligent Paradigm and executive vice president of Intelligent Resources–Integrated Systems.
accomplishments: Designed and programmed the Astrocade cartridges ICBM Attack and Treasure Cove for Spectre Systems.
Developed Cosmic Raiders as his first project at Action Graphics.
Contributed programs and technical material to the Arcadian and Cursor newsletters and to the AstroBASIC manual.
Led Apple's Technology Advancement Group and served as a lead designer on the Mac mini, Apple TV, and iSight technology for desktop and portable Macs.
Designed the Video Explorer computer video card before joining Apple.
Was credited by the University of Michigan–Dearborn with 59 patents covering consumer products and electronic applications.
